GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2013-01-31T10:38:01Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: 'Fetch' can't be bound to a 'change' event
Description: Hi,

I have a collection that listens to changes in a model to then update itself, like this:

```
this.listenTo(this.user, "change:addresses", this.fetch);
```

And it was getting back the user's own data, instead of the expected. After some probing I figured that `change` events pass `(model, value, options)` to the callbacks, which in this case meant `sync` was eventually getting the user model as it's `option` param.

The user model has its own url, and 8478567 means it is then overriding the collection's url for the request.

I understand this is an edge case, and can be easily circumvented by using `function(){ this.fetch(); }` instead, but maybe it deserves some looking into. Specially since I believe this also means `fetch` can't be bound to any event.

Right now I can't think of a good way to solve it that won't break 8478567, though. Maybe needing to explicitly state you want to override the request settings in `sync`?
